# Content Turbine

> Content Turbine is a technical content agency for B2B software and developer-tool companies. We run strategy, production, and optimization of technical content — guides, tutorials, documentation, sample apps, and thought leadership — written with subject-matter experts and optimized for both search engines and AI answer engines.

Site: https://www.contentturbine.com
Contact: https://www.contentturbine.com/contact

## What Content Turbine does

- **Discovery** — a 30-minute session to assess fit, goals, and the current state of your content.
- **Strategy** — stakeholder interviews ("brain dumps"), SEO/AEO research, and an editorial roadmap.
- **Create** — developer content, thought leadership, and product marketing assets.
- **Optimize** — content audits, performance analysis, and continuous improvement.

## Who it is for

Founders, heads of marketing, developer relations leads, and product marketers at technical B2B companies who need content developers actually trust.

## Key facts

- Every piece is expert-sourced and human-reviewed; AI is used for research and drafting only, never published raw.
- Engagements start with a free 30-minute discovery call.
- Services are delivered as packages rather than one-off deliverables.
- Content is optimized for traditional SEO and answer engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude).
